text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels rewarding, but I should avoid trimming winners automatically; decide based on my goals and the position’s outlook, not just the gain.","Repeatedly selling Stock D and other winners did not prevent my total account value from falling, so I should assess the whole portfolio rather than focus on realized gains.","I should not let loss aversion or my average cost dictate decisions; use a consistent plan for both winners and losers, and trade only when that plan calls for it."]}
